title: Hanasato Minori — Aiming To Be An Idol!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Pet House

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, bun-buns!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is our first time on duty. I hope I can do this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll be fine! Let's give them the best care we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: First of all, we should gather the bunnies into one corner so that we can clean the hutch without interference!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay. Let's see... Quietly from behind...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wah! P-Please stop wriggling!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh no... It ran away.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Most bunnies don't like to be held.
But don't worry! Look at this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, bunnies!
Come over here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: By getting the bunnies to climb onto your lap like this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And up!
Okay, wait in this room for a little while, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? You picked it up so easily!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The main thing is to make them to feel comfortable around us, so that they're not afraid of us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait for them to approach you instead, and then lift them up and support the butt like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's amazing! Okay, I can do this too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The bunnies in the hutch should be very used to being handled. You'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Just wait patiently, and they'll come.
Then lift them up gently by tucking your hand underneath, and...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I did it! I picked one up!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Well done, Kohane!
Okay, that was the last bunny.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Sh-She already transferred most of the bunnies into the room while I was struggling with just one?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now we have to sweep the hutch.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Okay. You're so good with this, Minori.
Were you also in the caretaker committee during middle school?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was! I've been in the caretaker committee since elementary school because I love caring for animals!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (She's cleaning up the area so quickly as we're talking!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have a dog at home too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? What kind of dog?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
A large breed of dog called a Samoyed.
The name is Samo!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Samo's such a cute name.
Here, the dustpan.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks! What about you, Kohane?
Do you keep any pets at home?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
My father keeps a snake at home.
She's all white, so we call her Count Pearl.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You have a snake?!
Wait, wait, what does it feel like to pet a snake?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we're done with the cleanup!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was fast...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's like...
When you're doing this, you seem a lot more... Well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha, I'm a lot faster and more efficient than usual?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? No, I...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it!
Lots of people said the same thing about me in middle school, too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm super confident in animal caretaking!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, the sooner we finish cleaning the hutch...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Finish cleaning the hutch...and? Ahh!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, it's nuzzling you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-That tickles...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The others are coming closer too.
Let's feed them now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Here... Wow, they're eating the food so quickly!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's so cute when they're munching away like that... My soul has been healed.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Aww, you're so fluffy...and so cute...
This is my favorite part. Feeding them while petting them like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Just now, when you spoke about finishing the clean up sooner, you meant...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! Finishing sooner gives us more time to pet them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, I thought so.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're so fluffy...
I can't wait for my turn to care for you again!
